observations: Eight chronological waves now contain no adjudicated clean direct contradiction to S1-S10; this cannot be interpreted as universal confirmation.
Blind Deep-Anchor coding exact agreement falls to 45/120 = 0.375; coarse applicability is 66/120 = 0.550.

The blind coder returns 53/120 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE judgments, while the frozen primary coder returned zero. This is direct evidence that primary historical interpretation was too willing to complete causal structure beyond thin source packets.
S1 is comparatively robust in HD8 (12/12 coarse); S2, S5, S6 and S8 are strongly evidence-depth-sensitive and should not be assigned historical frequency from thin records.

No blind CONTRADICTS appear even under this stricter evidence posture. The likely problem is partly claim type: several S statements are non-collapse guardrails or methodological/normative constraints for which ordinary historical trajectories rarely furnish clean logical negations.
Modern replay is unusable as positive discovery evidence because pretrained future-specific knowledge leaks through both unscaffolded and affordance-bounded treatments.
